description: Shared test vectors for signup-guard. Both the JavaScript and the PHP suites run every case against the fixture data below, never against the bundled snapshot, so weekly data updates cannot break them. "throws" holds the error code.

out.name: Gmail
out.note: Dots do not matter and +tags reach the same inbox. googlemail.com delivers to the same account. Google Workspace domains are not covered: dots matter there.

out.name: Proton Mail
out.note: Plus aliases arrive in the regular inbox. The four domains are not merged: Proton does not document that one name owns all of them.

out.name: Fastmail
out.note: Plus addressing and subdomain addressing (anything@user.fastmail.com) work by default. Only these two of the many Fastmail domains are covered.

out.name: Yandex Mail
out.note: Yandex suggests adding + and a word to the login when registering on websites. Other Yandex domain aliases are not listed by Yandex, so they are not covered.

out.name: Outlook.com
out.note: Not applied. Microsoft documents plus addressing for Exchange Online organizations, not for consumer Outlook.com. Opt in with plusTagDomains if you accept that.

out.name: iCloud Mail
out.note: Not applied. Apple documents neither plus addressing nor that name@me.com and name@icloud.com always belong to the same account.

out.name: Yahoo Mail
out.note: Not applied. Yahoo disposable addresses are basename-keyword, but the basename is chosen separately from the account name, so removing the keyword does not recover the real address.
